description: Creates a sentence-level outline for a technical paper Introduction from a structured six-paragraph Flowchart: background and running example, existing limitations, problem essence and goal, key challenges, solution overview, contributions. Produces what each sentence should accomplish, not polished prose. Positions the paper as Technique or New Problem/Setting and aligns contributions with challenges. Use when the user asks to plan, draft, outline, or clarify the Introduction, especially before writing final prose.
